items.source: Returns whether the current property is readable through PersistentPropertyAccessor, i.e. if it is not PersistentProperty.isTransient(), if the value can be set on the current instance or read to create a new instance as per PersistentProperty.getWither() or via Kotlin Copy methods.
items.translation: 返回当前属性是否可通过 PersistentPropertyAccessor 读取，即该属性并非 PersistentProperty.isTransient() 所定义的瞬态属性，且其值可根据 PersistentProperty.getWither() 或 Kotlin 的 Copy 方法在当前实例上设置或读取以创建新实例。

items.source: Return the type the property refers to in case it's an association, i.e. PersistentProperty.isAssociation() returns true. That means, that implementations must return a non-null value from this method in that case. We also recommend to return null for non-associations right away to establish symmetry between this method and PersistentProperty.isAssociation().
items.translation: 在关联的情况下，返回该属性所指向的类型；也就是说，如果PersistentProperty.isAssociation()返回true，则实现类必须从此方法返回一个非null值。此外，我们建议对于非关联的情况直接返回null，以在此方法与PersistentProperty.isAssociation()之间建立对称性。
